question: Do refreshed source records resolve Navarro identity holds, and do the new human GEO matrices qualify for a separate donor-paired context description?
decision: Resolve only evidence-supported joins; retain aged-brain holds and qualify external data by source, units and matrix semantics.
strongest_rival: Shared alias labels or donor IDs across different studies could be mistaken for a verified dose mapping or replication of D25K effects.
discriminator: Exact source versions and semantic BioSample comparison; explicit GSM-library descriptions; all matrix headers, integer counts, unique genes and complete donor strata.
exposure_record: Navarro outcomes and diagnostics were exposed previously. New Nature/GEO study title, reported direction, sample characteristics and matrix headers were read before freeze; no expression contrast has been calculated.
biological_unit: Reported within-series human donor for possible later context; pooled mouse library for original Navarro. This stage qualifies metadata only.
nesting_and_overlap: Human treatment/time/activation samples are nested in donor. Repeated D1/D2/D3 labels across GEO series are not a cross-study person join.
population_and_selection: Exact public metadata snapshots and complete supplied gene-count matrices for GSE318914 and GSE318915; original Navarro source records.
contrast: Original versus refreshed source identity; declared sample design versus count-matrix columns. No gene-expression contrasts.
endpoint: Source versions, sample/library joins, matrix dimensions/count integrity, donor strata and explicit eligibility/holds.
methods: Parse exact frozen XML/JSON/TSV/SOFT inputs; require unchanged Navarro source versions for an unchanged-source disposition; validate every matrix row and sample join before any external description.
missingness_and_exclusions: No sample or gene filtering. Missing donor/library/marker identity, duplicate features, negative/noninteger counts or incomplete treatment strata stop the dependent description.
multiplicity: Metadata and arithmetic checks only; no inferential P values or confidence intervals.
precision_basis: No population precision estimate. Exact stored recovery counts and bounded numerical tolerance qualify file arithmetic only.
interpretation_limit: No biological replication, population treatment effect, age interaction, mediation or repair inference. Downstream microglia exclusions and filename changes must remain distinct from broad deposited cells.
stop_rule: Stop if source identities change unexpectedly, counts or joins fail, or a requested marker symbol maps to multiple or no feature IDs. Never invent an alias or donor join.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized remaining-work follow-up and public sourcing after the completed Navarro run. Adds dated external-source qualification without revising prior evidence.
